description: Swiss Public Transport Stops is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "infrastructure, transportation", published or maintained by Swiss Geoportal. The basic geo-data set for public transport stops comprises public transport stops in Switzerland and additional selected geo-referenced public transport locations that are of operational or structural importance (operating points). Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tags infrastructure, transportation and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: annually. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is stated as "You may use this dataset for non-commercial purposes." on the registry page. Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
